summary: TypeScript SDK for SOX Protocol v1.0. Mirrors the Python client surface and is the sole client dependency of chat-webapp. Ships browser+Node ESM/CJS bundles, generated TS types from spec/operations and spec/envelopes (covering all 16 schemas including the 8 added by 03-reconcile: channels_ack, channels_heartbeat, channels_collect, replay, plus updated send/recv/list_channels and the group lifecycle), and a small set of higher-level helpers (askAndWait, reply, drain, bootstrap) sized to back the chat-webapp component tree. Public API is intentionally aligned with the React component props in the chat-webapp plan to avoid adapter shims.

package_layout.tsconfig: extends repo base; target ES2022; module NodeNext; lib DOM,ES2022; strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess + exactOptionalPropertyTypes

codegen.approach: json-schema-to-typescript invoked programmatically; one .ts per schema file; barrel index.ts re-exports; emits ajv-compatible JSON copies under generated/schemas/ for runtime validation
codegen.note: MUST cover all 28 schema files in spec/operations + 4 in spec/envelopes. Specifically: channels_ack.{input,output}, channels_heartbeat.{input,output}, channels_collect.{input,output}, replay.{input,output}, list_channels.{input,output} (with _sox_protocol block), recv.{input,output} (with seq, ts, ancestors, _meta), send.{input,output} (with seq + backpressure), subscribe, unsubscribe, group_create, group_invite, group_join, group_leave, group_list_members, plus envelopes sox-ack/sox-nack/sox-error/sox-invite. Run as a prebuild step; CI checks the directory is up-to-date with `git diff --exit-code packages/typescript/src/generated/`.
codegen.determinism: stable property ordering; header banner with schema $id and SHA

files.purpose: ergonomic compositions on top of SoxClient; sized to back chat-webapp components
public_api: bootstrap(client, { patterns, namespace? }): Promise<{ protocolVersion, lastSeqByChannel }>  // calls listChannels (version handshake) then subscribe; returns per-channel seq cursor map for replay-on-reconnect
askAndWait(client, { channel, body, timeoutMs, correlationId? }): Promise<Envelope>  // sends; resolves on first matching reply (matches via reply_to == sent message_id)
reply(client, parent: Envelope, body): Promise<SendOutput>  // sets reply_to=parent.message_id, channel=parent.channel; auto-correlation_id passthrough
drain(client, { onMessage, signal? }): Promise<void>  // pulls recv in a loop, surfaces seq, exits on signal abort
openDm(client, peerAgentId): { channel: string }  // canonicalises dm/<sorted-pair> name (lex sort, ~ separator) — used by webapp DM view + reference-agent

risks.risk: Browser EventSource cannot send custom auth headers
risks.mitigation: fall back to query-param token on SSE endpoints; document threat model; encourage reverse proxy in production

risks.risk: Bundle size creep from ajv runtime validator
risks.mitigation: validate.ts is opt-in via separate import path; tree-shaken from default bundle; <50KB minified target verified in CI

risks.risk: Codegen drift between Python and TS types
risks.mitigation: single source = spec/*.json; CI runs ts_codegen.ts and asserts no diff

risks.risk: ack-as-tool vs ack-as-message confusion in user code
risks.mitigation: no body.type='sox-ack' literal in any TS type; client.channelsAck is the only entry point; doc snippet warns against legacy pattern

risks.risk: DM name canonicalisation mismatch between client and server
risks.mitigation: shared canonicalDmName helper; integration test asserts server accepts the client-canonicalised form; unicode test vector
